legacy_mqtt_discovery.title: Disable duplicate SurvNG MQTT discovery
legacy_mqtt_discovery.description: {entry_title} is publishing legacy Home Assistant MQTT discovery while the SurvNG integration owns the same devices. Disable Home Assistant Discovery in SurvNG Admin > General > API, then remove the duplicate MQTT-discovered entities.

user.title: Connect to SurvNG
user.description: Create a read + camera-control token in SurvNG Admin > General > API. HTTPS is required unless you explicitly allow insecure HTTP for a trusted local network.

error.tls_error: SurvNG's TLS certificate could not be verified. Install the issuing CA in Home Assistant or disable TLS verification only for a trusted private network.
error.invalid_auth: The API token is invalid or lacks required scopes
